text:
alex: FYI: during tonight's scheduled KMS key rotation for tenant-kms-prod we observed an uptick in SAML assertion validation errors from our EU IdP and a correlated rise in SCIM 500s. Opening thread to coordinate triage.

tara: seeing same. SAML SP logs show 'invalid signature' for assertions signed right after rotation window (2024-12-02T02:00Z). SCIM requests tied to those users are failing with 500s because user lookup relies on assertion attributes.

security-bot: alert: potential vuln triage required - rotation mismatch detected (key-id mismatch) - ticket SEC-4991 created automatically.

lou: quick question: was the KMS rotation a seamless rewrap (new alias -> same key material) or full rekey? If we swapped to an entirely new public key, IdPs need their SP metadata updated.

alex: it's a full rekey (rotate+reprovision). We updated metadata in the control plane at 02:02Z but the metadata push to idp-config-bucket errored with 403 during the window.

ben: I'm pulling S3 push logs now. Found 02:01:15Z PUT failed -> AccessDenied for idp-config-bucket:config.json; retries completed at 02:03:30Z succeeded. So IdP got a stale cert for ~2m.

tara: that 2m explains a burst of invalid-sig errors. IdP retried, then issued assertion with new key, but some sessions had old cached metadata at their end causing signature validation to fail intermittently.

oncall-sec: impact assessment: how many auth events failed?

alex: 480 failed assertions across multiple tenants; roughly 0.4% of total logins in the window. SCIM create/update errors ~300, mostly backfill attempts, and 18 duplicate entries detected in provisioning DB. No user data exfiltration signs.

lou: remediation plan: 1) Confirm idp-config-bucket ACL fix and add retry/backoff + alert on 5xx/403 for metadata pushes. 2) Backfill audit events for provisioning failures. 3) Add a canary flow so future KMS metadata pushes verify IdP trust path before marking rotation complete.

ben: added temporary webhook auth bypass flag for the SCIM backfill job so retries don't create dupe users while we reconcile externalIds. Flag: PROVISION_BACKFILL_DEDUP=true (ops only).

security-bot: note: compliance requires rotations to be coordinated with IdP 24h window; filing update to rotation playbook.

alex: vuln triage note: we also saw a CVE notification yesterday for old-xmlsec lib used by sso-proxy. Not directly exploited but during rotation the proxy codepath that validates signatures uses xmlsec. I'm going to open a patch PR to update to 2.3.4 and include it in the rollback/patch plan.

tara: prioritize patching xmlsec on the proxy, but rolling that now may affect live session handling. Schedule patch during next low-traffic window and gate with canary.

lou: for immediate fix: we've re-run metadata push with validated ACLs, and IdP confirmed refetch. I recommend a manual reconciliation of provisioning table: run dedupe based on externalId, then rebuild audit-event correlation ids from provisioning logs between 02:00-02:10Z. I'll draft SQL steps.

alex: SQL steps: 1) create temp table ext_map (externalId, canonical_user_id) from latest successful user records; 2) update audit_events set user_id = canonical_user_id where provisioning_req_id in (select req_id from provisioning_logs where ts between '2024-12-02T02:00:00Z' and '2024-12-02T02:10:00Z'); 3) delete duplicates in users where source='backfill' and externalId in ext_map and user_id != canonical_user_id. (Ops: run with tx + backup).

oncall-sec: I'll coordinate DB window. Need owner for postmortem and to file follow-ups. Assigning SEC-4991 to tara for postmortem, and SEC-4992 to lou for playbook updates.

ben: deployed a short-lived guard in sso-proxy: when KMS rotation flag is true, block metadata transitions to 'active' until IdP re-ack is observed. This prevents half-complete rotations.

alex: adding monitoring: create metric rotation_failure_seconds and an alert if >30s, and scim_backfill_dup_rate > 0.1 for >5m.

tara: also document RBAC note: our admin role 'infra:rotations' was missing the s3:PutObjectAcl permission so the push failed. We've updated role and added unit test for infra:rotations role perms in CI.

lou: vulnerability follow-up: run xmlsec upgrade in a canary group of proxies after the DB reconciliation. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime.

oncall-sec: closing loop: mitigate in prod (ACL fix + dedupe + temp backfill dedup flag), schedule xmlsec patch, update playbooks, add canary verification step to KMS rotation runbook. Postmortem owner tara, due EOD tomorrow.

alex: thanks everyone. saving repro/traces to /var/ops/rotations/6991234599 and attaching to SEC-4991.

ben: deploy-bot: patch queued: sso-proxy xmlsec-2.3.4-pr #821 by ben.

security-bot: created follow-ups: SEC-4991 (postmortem), SEC-4992 (rotation playbook), SEC-4993 (CI role-perm test).

tara: will write the incident summary and notify SOC channel once postmortem is posted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
